content: Irrigation decision rule: Skip irrigation if rainfall probability exceeds 60% within 24 hours. Irrigate in early morning (5–7 AM) to minimize evaporation. Optimal irrigation temperature range: 20–32°C. Avoid irrigation when wind speed exceeds 30 km/h.

Harvest window rules: Ideal conditions require rain probability below 30%, wind speed below 25 km/h, and no storm warnings. Harvest rice within 3 days of maturity to avoid grain loss. Avoid harvesting during or immediately after heavy rain — wet grain causes mold.

Plant disease risk assessment: High fungal disease risk when relative humidity exceeds 80% for more than 6 consecutive hours combined with temperatures between 20–30°C. Blast disease in rice is favored by leaf wetness duration above 8 hours. Apply fungicide preventively when humidity > 85%.

Cold and frost risk: Protect tropical crops when minimum temperature drops below 15°C. Rice seedlings are sensitive to cold below 12°C — apply cover or delay transplanting. In Central Vietnam highlands (Da Lat, Kon Tum), frost risk increases between December and February.

Mekong Delta rice farming context: The Mekong Delta (Đồng bằng sông Cửu Long) produces 50% of Vietnam's rice. Three crop seasons: Winter-Spring (Dec–Mar), Summer-Autumn (Apr–Jul), Autumn-Winter (Aug–Nov). Flood season peaks July–October. Salinity intrusion risk increases in dry season (Feb–May). Optimal water level for rice paddies: 5–10 cm.

Central Vietnam agriculture context (Da Nang, Quang Nam, Thua Thien Hue): Rainy season October–December brings typhoon risk and flash floods. Dry season April–September ideal for crop growth but requires irrigation. Main crops: rice, vegetables, pepper, cassava. Typhoon risk is highest September–November.
